plan.title: Award a Lot to One Vendor

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow, which supports selecting whole-lot awarding.
Enable the required lot-based awarding configuration before creating the event.
Configure an auction whose entire lot is awarded to a single vendor.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Create multiple line items as the closest expressible approximation of a lot with staggered lines.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line items.
Commit the event schedule so it can be published.
Invite one QA vendor to receive and submit the lot bid.
Confirm the event was published successfully before bidding.
Have the invited vendor submit a bid for the event.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the bidding window so awarding is available.
Award the closed event to the available lowest bidder using the whole-lot awarding configuration.
Confirm that the award proposal was created and submitted.
